comment: The single tolerance table of the tree. A value matches when |expected - actual| <= absolute + relative * |expected|. Provisional until the first full comparison calibrates it (Fixtures BOOT.md).

temperature.derivation: CEA prints temperatures to 0.01 K and stops its hp and sp iterations at 5e-5 on the relative temperature correction (RP-1311, section 3.2); 2e-5 relative on a 3500 K chamber is 0.07 K, and 0.05 K covers the print precision at low temperatures.

pressure.derivation: Exact where assigned (derived cases, pressure-ratio exits). At the throat and at area-ratio exits the reference stops its iterations at 4e-5 on the sonic ratio and on the correction of ln(pc/pe) (RP-1311, equations 6.16 and 6.25) and reports the pressure of its last iterate; up to 3.9e-5 relative was observed against the tree, which iterates to 1e-10. Calibrated 2026-09-12 from 1e-5.

density.derivation: Derived from T, p and the molar mass; the product of their tolerances.

enthalpy.derivation: Enthalpy passes through zero; 20 J/kg is 1e-5 of a typical 2 MJ/kg magnitude and covers the 0.01 kJ/kg print precision of the reference.

entropy.derivation: Printed with four decimals in kJ/(kg K) on magnitudes of 10 to 20; 1e-4 relative.

molarMass.derivation: Follows the composition; printed with three decimals on magnitudes of 10 to 30.

mixtureMolarMass.derivation: As molarMass; the reference's MW, one kilogram over the moles of all species with the condensed ones counted.

cpFrozen.derivation: A sum of species functions weighted by the composition; the composition tolerance dominates.

cpEquilibrium.derivation: Contains the equilibrium derivatives, which are solutions of the same linear system as the composition corrections.

gammaS.derivation: Printed with four decimals on magnitudes near 1.2.

dlnVdlnT.derivation: Derived in the generator from the package's cp, cv, gamma_s and M (cea_cases.py); inherits their tolerance.

soundSpeed.derivation: sqrt(gamma_s R T / M); half the relative tolerance of its factors, rounded up.

mach.derivation: The throat Mach number is 1 within 2e-5 by the sonic criterion; exits follow the area-ratio iteration.

moleFraction.derivation: CEA prints mole fractions above 5e-6 with five significant digits and lists the rest as trace species; the equilibrium iteration stops at 5e-7 on the mole-number corrections (RP-1311, section 3.2).

moleFractionTrace.derivation: A species the reference reports below 5e-6 is only asserted to stay below 1e-5 in the tree: the trace tail depends on the iteration path.

moleFractionFloor.derivation: Not a comparison with the reference: two paths of the tree's own code reaching the same mole fraction (CUDA against the CPU accelerator; a case solved alone against the same case inside a batch whose union reorders its elements). Below this a mole fraction's logarithm has not converged to the same digits on both paths, so comparisons below it assert nothing. Moved here 2026-09-14 from the execution tests node's GpuCpuTolerances (the architecture review's F-TF-05), which the front door tests node also depended on for its union-batch comparison without being allowed to read that node's code; the execution tests node's own table keeps its GPU-specific entries.

polishThresholdRelative.derivation: Not a comparison with the reference: the second tier for a mole fraction reached by two paths of the tree's own code that may stop the equilibrium solver's Newton polish after a different number of steps (CUDA against the CPU accelerator; a case solved alone against the same case inside a reordered union batch). The polish stops once its corrections fall below 1e-11, the rounding floor of the linear solves, and a last-ULP difference at that floor moves ln n_j by dln n + (H_j/RT) dln T + sum_i a_ij dpi_i, every term of the order of the threshold, so a species with |H_j/RT| and sum_i a_ij of a few tens moves by a few 1e-10 (measured 3.3e-10 on HO2 in the execution tests node's 100000-case sweep). Moved here 2026-09-14 from that node's GpuCpuTolerances (the architecture review's F-TF-05); its own table keeps the entry for its own accelerator comparison, since the sweep's step-count share is CUDA-specific.

areaRatio.derivation: An input for area-ratio stations (reproduced to 1e-7 by the reference), a result for pressure-ratio stations.

pressureRatio.derivation: As areaRatio, with the roles of input and result exchanged.

characteristicVelocity.derivation: p_c / (rho_t u_t); printed with one decimal on magnitudes near 2000 m/s.

thrustCoefficient.derivation: Isp / c*; printed with four decimals.

specificImpulse.derivation: The exit velocity; printed with one decimal on magnitudes near 4000 m/s.

viscosity.derivation: The reference prints transport properties with five significant digits; the mixture rules sum over the pairs of the transport set, with interaction fits where the file has them and the reference's estimates for species and pairs without data on both sides. On the reference composition the tree reproduces the field to 3.4e-8 (2026-09-12); the budget is for the comparison on the tree's own composition.

reactingConductivity.derivation: Adds the reaction term of Butler and Brokaw over the independent reactions of the transport set; as viscosity. Not compared at the stations where the reference is defective (BOOT.md, the trace-component caveat).

thermoFunction.derivation: The same polynomial evaluated in double precision by two programs; the difference is rounding, at most a few units in the last place of the largest term. The absolute part covers values that pass through zero.

transportFit.derivation: The same fit evaluated in double precision by two programs: exp of a four-term sum.

gasConstant.derivation: A constant typed in both places; equality is exact.
